sections.title: Add the DNS records at your provider
sections.summary: Copy each DNS record shown in the table here into your domain provider's DNS settings exactly as displayed — the record type, the name/host, and the value all have to match. After you save them at the provider, wait before verifying: DNS changes take from a few minutes up to a few hours to spread across the internet, and verification only passes once they're live.

sections.title: If verification keeps failing
sections.summary: First, remove any older CNAME or A record on the same host that conflicts with the new one. Second, if your domain is on Cloudflare, set the record to 'DNS only' — click the orange cloud icon so it turns grey. The orange cloud means Cloudflare is hiding (proxying) your real record, which stops Segmently from confirming it.
